flag.meaning: Cloth that waves on a pole.

stamp.meaning: A small picture used to send mail.

ring.meaning: A little circle you can wear.

rabbit.meaning: A furry animal with long ears.

napkin.meaning: A cloth or paper for wiping.

dentist.meaning: A person who cares for teeth.

cactus.meaning: A plant often covered with spines.

insect.meaning: A small animal with six legs.

seed.meaning: Something a new plant can grow from.

tree.meaning: A tall plant with a trunk.

sail.meaning: Cloth that catches wind on a boat.

boat.meaning: Something that carries people on water.

goat.meaning: An animal that often has horns.

name.meaning: What someone or something is called.

kite.meaning: A toy that flies on a string.

bone.meaning: A hard part inside a body.

a.note: A means one. In a sentence it often sounds like “uh”.

an.note: An means one, before a vowel sound.

is.note: In is, s spells the buzzing /z/ sound.

has.note: Has means owns or holds. Its s spells /z/.

can.note: Can means able to. Its vowel is often relaxed in a sentence.

lessons.title: Keep both starting sounds
lessons.cue: Slide through each sound. Keep both sounds at the start.
lessons.sentence: A cat can spin.
lessons.alternateSentence: A dog can stop.

lessons.title: Little l blends
lessons.cue: Keep the l sound as you blend the whole word.
lessons.sentence: A flag can flap.
lessons.alternateSentence: A cat can clap.

lessons.title: Little r blends
lessons.cue: Say both starting sounds, then blend to the end.
lessons.sentence: A frog can hop.
lessons.alternateSentence: A frog can grin.

lessons.title: Keep the ending
lessons.cue: Read right to the last sound. Do not leave the ending behind.
lessons.sentence: An ant is in a tent.
lessons.alternateSentence: An ant is on a hand.

lessons.title: More ending blends
lessons.cue: Keep both sounds at the end.
lessons.sentence: A frog can jump.
lessons.alternateSentence: A cat can jump.

lessons.title: Blends at both ends
lessons.cue: Blend all the way through, from the first sound to the last.
lessons.sentence: A plant is in a pot.
lessons.alternateSentence: A stamp is on a bag.

lessons.title: Two letters, one sh sound
lessons.cue: In these words, s and h work together to spell one sound.
lessons.sentence: A fish is in a dish.
lessons.alternateSentence: A fish is in a ship.

lessons.title: Two letters, one ch sound
lessons.cue: In these words, c and h work together to spell one sound.
lessons.sentence: A chip is in a bag.
lessons.alternateSentence: A chip is in a dish.

lessons.title: Two letters, one th sound
lessons.cue: Listen to the beginning of thin. The two letters spell one sound.
lessons.sentence: A moth is in a bath.
lessons.alternateSentence: A thin cat is in a bath.

lessons.title: Listen for ng
lessons.cue: At the end of sing, n and g work together to spell one sound.
lessons.sentence: A long song is fun.
lessons.alternateSentence: A long song can help.

meaningPrompts.question: What does the sentence tell us?
What can a long song do?

lessons.title: Read the ing ending
lessons.cue: Read the base word, then add ing. An extra consonant keeps the vowel short.
lessons.sentence: A cat is jumping.
lessons.alternateSentence: A frog is jumping.

meaningPrompts.question: What does the sentence tell us?
What does the sentence tell us?

lessons.title: Two small parts
lessons.cue: Read each part, then put the parts together into one word.
lessons.sentence: A rabbit can hop.
lessons.alternateSentence: A rabbit is at a picnic.

lessons.title: Longer words you can build
lessons.cue: Find the two readable parts, then blend them together.
lessons.sentence: A bedbug is on a bed.
lessons.alternateSentence: A cat is on a sunlit bed.

lessons.title: Longer word adventure
lessons.cue: Read each part carefully. Say the whole word naturally.
lessons.sentence: An insect is on a cactus.
lessons.alternateSentence: A dentist can help.

lessons.title: Final ck
lessons.cue: After a short vowel, ck spells one sound.
lessons.sentence: A duck is in a pond.
lessons.alternateSentence: A sock is on a bed.

lessons.title: Doubled endings
lessons.cue: Two matching letters can spell one ending sound.
lessons.sentence: A bell is on a desk.
lessons.alternateSentence: A cat is on a hill.

lessons.title: Long a with silent e
lessons.cue: The a and final e work together. Hear the long a.
lessons.sentence: A cake is on a plate.
lessons.alternateSentence: A name is on a gate.

lessons.title: Long i with silent e
lessons.cue: The i and final e work together. Hear the long i.
lessons.sentence: A kite is on a hill.
lessons.alternateSentence: A bike is at a gate.

lessons.title: Long o with silent e
lessons.cue: The o and final e work together. Hear the long o.
lessons.sentence: A dog has a bone.
lessons.alternateSentence: A rope is on a gate.

lessons.title: Silent-e mix
lessons.cue: Look for the vowel and its partner e. Blend the whole word.
lessons.sentence: A kite is at home.
lessons.alternateSentence: A rope is in a lake.

lessons.title: Two e letters
lessons.cue: The ee team spells one long e sound.
lessons.sentence: A seed is in a pot.
lessons.alternateSentence: A tree is green.

meaningPrompts.question: What does the sentence tell us?

lessons.title: The ai team
lessons.cue: The ai team spells one long a sound.
lessons.sentence: Rain is on a green tree.
lessons.alternateSentence: A dog has a tail.

lessons.title: The oa team
lessons.cue: The oa team spells one long o sound.
lessons.sentence: A goat is on a boat.
lessons.alternateSentence: Soap is in a dish.

lessons.title: Vowel-team mix
lessons.cue: Spot the team, then blend the whole word.
lessons.sentence: A goat is in a boat.
lessons.alternateSentence: Rain is on a seed.
